question: What is the gender of patient 12345?
examples: What is the sex of patient 67890?
sql: SELECT gender FROM patients WHERE subject_id = 12345 LIMIT 1;

question: When was patient 67890 born?
sql: SELECT dob FROM patients WHERE subject_id = 67890 LIMIT 1;

pattern: length of stay – last hospital admission
description: Compute duration of last hospital stay (days)
question: What is the length of stay of the patient's last hospital visit?
sql: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, admittime, dischtime) AS los FROM admissions WHERE subject_id = 12345 AND dischtime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY admittime DESC LIMIT 1;

question: When was the patient's first hospital admission?
sql: SELECT admittime FROM admissions WHERE subject_id = 12345 ORDER BY admittime ASC LIMIT 1;

description: Retrieve diagnosis of the most recent admission
question: What was the diagnosis of the patient's last admission?
sql: SELECT d.long_title FROM diagnoses_icd di JOIN d_icd_diagnoses d ON di.icd9_code = d.icd9_code WHERE di.subject_id = 12345 ORDER BY di.row_id DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How long did the patient stay in the ICU during the last ICU visit?
examples: ICU LOS of most recent stay?
sql: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, intime, outtime) AS los FROM icustays WHERE subject_id = 12345 AND outtime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY intime DESC LIMIT 1;

description: Count total hospital admissions of a patient
question: How many times was the patient admitted to the hospital?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS admission_count FROM admissions WHERE subject_id = 12345;

description: Check if patient ever had a specific diagnosis
question: Did the patient ever have a diagnosis of pneumonia?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count FROM diagnoses_icd di JOIN d_icd_diagnoses d ON di.icd9_code = d.icd9_code WHERE di.subject_id = 12345 AND LOWER(d.long_title) LIKE '%pneumonia%';

description: Check if a patient was prescribed a specific drug
question: Was the patient prescribed warfarin?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM prescriptions WHERE subject_id = 12345 AND LOWER(drug) = 'warfarin';

description: Retrieve numeric value of a lab test
question: What was the patient's glucose level?
sql: SELECT le.valuenum FROM labevents le JOIN d_labitems d ON le.itemid = d.itemid WHERE le.subject_id = 12345 AND LOWER(d.label) = 'glucose' AND le.valuenum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY le.charttime DESC LIMIT 1;

description: Compute absolute change between first two lab values
question: What was the change in potassium level during the admission?
sql: SELECT ABS(v2.valuenum - v1.valuenum) FROM (SELECT le.valuenum FROM labevents le JOIN d_labitems d ON le.itemid = d.itemid WHERE le.subject_id = 12345 AND LOWER(d.label) = 'potassium' AND le.valuenum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY le.charttime ASC LIMIT 1) v1 JOIN (SELECT le.valuenum FROM labevents le JOIN d_labitems d ON le.itemid = d.itemid WHERE le.subject_id = 12345 AND LOWER(d.label) = 'potassium' AND le.valuenum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY le.charttime ASC LIMIT 1,1) v2;

description: Retrieve most recent lab value during last admission
question: What was the latest sodium level during the patient's last admission?
sql: SELECT le.valuenum FROM labevents le JOIN d_labitems d ON le.itemid = d.itemid WHERE le.subject_id = 12345 AND le.hadm_id = (SELECT hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE subject_id = 12345 ORDER BY admittime DESC LIMIT 1) AND LOWER(d.label) = 'sodium' AND le.valuenum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY le.charttime DESC LIMIT 1;

description: Compute average lab value over all measurements
question: What was the average glucose level for the patient?
sql: SELECT AVG(le.valuenum) AS avg_value FROM labevents le JOIN d_labitems d ON le.itemid = d.itemid WHERE le.subject_id = 12345 AND LOWER(d.label) = 'glucose' AND le.valuenum IS NOT NULL;

description: Retrieve the cost of a medical procedure using ICD procedure short title
question: What is the price of a procedure named soft tissue division nec?
examples: How much does the procedure soft tissue division nec cost?
What is the cost of soft tissue division nec?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cost.cost FROM cost WHERE cost.event_type = 'procedures_icd' AND cost.event_id IN ( SELECT procedures_icd.row_id FROM procedures_icd WHERE procedures_icd.icd9_code = ( SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd9_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.short_title = 'soft tissue division nec' ) );

description: Retrieve the cost of a wound dressing procedure
question: How much to pay for a dressing of wound nec?
examples: What is the cost of a dressing of wound nec?
How much does wound dressing nec cost?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cost.cost FROM cost WHERE cost.event_type = 'procedures_icd' AND cost.event_id IN ( SELECT procedures_icd.row_id FROM procedures_icd WHERE procedures_icd.icd9_code = ( SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd9_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.short_title = 'dressing of wound nec' ) );

description: Retrieve the cost of a heart vessel procedure
question: What is heart vessel op nec's price?
examples: What is the cost of heart vessel op nec?
How much does heart vessel op nec procedure cost?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cost.cost FROM cost WHERE cost.event_type = 'procedures_icd' AND cost.event_id IN ( SELECT procedures_icd.row_id FROM procedures_icd WHERE procedures_icd.icd9_code = ( SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd9_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.short_title = 'heart vessel op nec' ) );

question: What is the 30-day readmission rate for patients discharged from the hospital?
examples: How many patients are readmitted within 30 days after discharge?
What percentage of discharged patients return to the hospital within 30 days?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.subject_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a1.subject_id) AS readmission_rate_30_days FROM admissions a1 LEFT JOIN admissions a2 ON a1.subject_id = a2.subject_id AND a2.admittime > a1.dischtime AND a2.admittime <= a1.dischtime + INTERVAL 30 DAY;
